Tikal is located approximately 64 km from Flores, a town on an island in Lake Petén Itzá. Thousands of structures survive at the archaeological site of this ancient city, including six especially prominent tall pyramidal temples. The national park covers about 575 km² and is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for both its cultural and natural significance.

This excursion focuses on the archaeological complex itself. A separate included lunch is not specified in the program.

From Petén, you will travel to Tikal. Your guide will introduce you to this city of the Classic Maya civilization and its archaeological complex surrounded by tropical rainforest. The visit to Tikal and guiding services are included in the program.

Lunch will be served within the complex. After the excursion, you will return to Petén. The rest of the day on the tour can be spent walking independently around the island of Flores or relaxing with views of Lake Petén Itzá.

After crossing the border into Bolivia, the route leads to Copacabana on the shores of Lake Titicaca. Here you board a catamaran and travel to Isla del Sol, the Island of the Sun.

On the island, a symbolic ritual of the Kallawaya people introduces you to Andean traditions. Lunch on the lake is included. On the "Enchanting Peru and Bolivia" tour, the journey continues by road to La Paz after the lake portion of the itinerary.

Interpreter services during the Lake Titicaca crossing are not included in the price of this tour.

After crossing the Bolivian border, the route continues to Copacabana. The town on the shores of Lake Titicaca is known as the "Bolivian Rome."

From Copacabana, a speedboat takes you to Isla del Sol. According to local traditions, the island is associated with the origins of the Inca civilization. On the island, you will discover local customs and take part in a symbolic Kallawaya ritual with offerings to Pachamama, Mother Earth.

Lunch is served at a restaurant overlooking the lake. You then return to the Bolivian shore; on the 15-day tour, the journey continues to La Paz by road. The terms of the border transfer and accompanying services depend on the selected tour.
